title: Consider `.cache/ruff` as the default project cache directory
author: keys-i
body_preview: Would you consider using `.cache/ruff` instead of `.ruff_cache` as Ruff’s default project cache directory?  The strongest reason is a clearer separation between project configuration and disposable generated data.
